==English==
[[File:Coffin-reliquary with remains of St. King Stefan Decanski.jpg|thumb|An ornate coffin]]

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɒfɪn/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɔfɪn/|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɑfɪn/|a=cot-caught}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-coffin.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɒfɪn|ɒfən|s=2}}
* {{homophones|en|coughing|qq=with g-dropping}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{inh|en|enm|coffyn}}, from {{der|en|fro-nor|cofin|t=sarcophagus", earlier "basket, coffer}}, from {{der|en|la|cophinus|t=basket}}, a loanword from {{der|en|grc|κόφινος|t=a basket}}. {{doublet|en|coffer}}. Displaced native {{ncog|ang|þrūh}}.

====Alternative forms====
* {{alt|en|cophin|coffyn||archaic}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q184418}}A closed box in which the [[body]] of a [[dead]] person is placed for [[burial]].
#: {{syn|en|casket|q1=US|pine box}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1865|author=w:Walt Whitman|title=Sequel to Drum-Taps: When Lilacs Last in the Dooryard Bloom’d and other poems|chapter=[[w:When Lilacs Last in the Dooryard Bloom'd|When Lilacs Last in the Dooryard Bloom’d]]
|passage={{...}} Passing the apple-tree blows of white and pink in the orchards, / Carrying a corpse to where it shall rest in the grave, / Night and day journeys a '''coffin'''.}}
#* '''20 May 2018''', Hadley Freeman in ''{{w|The Guardian}}'', ''[https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/may/20/is-meghan-markle-the-american-the-royals-needed-all-along Is Meghan Markle the American the royals have needed all along?]''
# {{lb|en|cartomancy}} The eighth [[Lenormand]] card.
# {{lb|en|archaic}} A casing or crust, or a mold, of pastry, as for a pie.
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Titus Andronicus|V|ii|passage=Of the paste a '''coffin''' I will rear.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1596|title=The Good Huswife's Jewell
|passage=Take your mallard and put him into the iuyce of the sayde Onyons, and season him with pepper, and salte, cloues and mace, then put your Mallard into the '''coffin''' with the saide iuyce of the onyons.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} A conical paper bag, used by grocers.
# The hollow crust or hoof of a horse's foot, below the coronet, in which is the [[coffin bone]].
# A [[storage]] [[container]] for [[nuclear waste]].
# A [[combination]] [[fence]] [[obstacle]] where the horse jumps a set of rails, strides downhill to a ditch, and then goes back uphill to another jump.
